newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Jan-Aug trade deficit rises to 2.25 bln. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Jan-Aug trade deficit rises to 2.25 bln. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]

text.p: Lithuania's trade deficit rose to 2.25 billion litas in the January to August period from 2.13 billion litas at the end of July, the statistics department said on Monday.
Note - all figures are in billions of litas unless otherwise stated.
